notes: Everything you have already played can be moved onto the story's calendar in one pass. Settings now has Story timeline: give it the day the story starts and the day it is now, and it reads every conversation, groups the messages into sittings wherever there was a real pause of three quarters of an hour or more, and asks the text model to place each sitting inside that span — using what was actually said, so a goodnight lands at night, a good morning early, and plans made for the next day fall the day before the thing happens. You see the whole plan as a list before anything changes: every sitting, who it was with, how many messages, and the day and time it would become. Apply re-dates them and moves the clock to your now. Order is enforced in code rather than trusted to the model, sittings are spread across the whole span instead of bunching at one end, and each one is given room so the last conversation cannot spill past the present. If the model is unreachable or answers unusably the sittings are simply spread evenly and it says so, so the tool still works. And it is completely reversible: one button puts every message back on the real time it was typed.
